title: Allegiant Travel CO 8-K Filing — 2026-04-20
summary: Allegiant Travel Company filed an 8-K announcing that its Nominating and Governance Committee approved two Sun Country designees (Jennifer Vogel and Thomas Kennedy) to join the Allegiant Board upon completion of the planned merger. The filing also disclosed an Advisory Services Agreement with Sun Country's CEO, Jude Bricker, effective post-merger at $26,250 per month.
key_points: Allegiant Travel and Sun Country Airlines merger announced January 11, 2026; expected to close in 2026
